stdout.pattern:
usage: git2 config [-z] [--system|--global|--local|--file=<filename>]
                    (--get|--add|--replace-all|--list) [--show-origin]
                    [--show-scope] [<name>] [<value>] [<regexp>]

Query and set configuration options.

Options:
    --get
        get a configuration value
    --add
        add a configuration value
    --replace-all
        add a configuration value, replacing any old values
    -l, --list
        list all configuration entries
    -z, --null
        use NUL as a separator
    --system
        read/write to system configuration
    --global
        read/write to global configuration
    --local
        read/write to local configuration
    --file=<filename>
        read/write to specified configuration file
    --show-origin
        show origin of configuration
    --show-scope
        show scope of configuration
    <name>
        name of configuration entry
    <value>
        value of configuration entry
    <regexp>
        regular expression of values to replace
